messages:
sasha: FYI support ticket 7893 — p95 for /v1/generate jumped from ~120ms -> ~420ms for cohort 'synth-100' after runtime 1.4.3 canary rolled to 20% at 09:12 UTC. Customers seeing degraded UX.
aj: Do we have traces? can you paste span ids + sample request?
sasha: Trace id abc123, sample request below. Minimal repro attached.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Cohort: synth-100' \
  -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":64}'
```
maria: Deploy bot shows 1.4.3 canary at 20% at 09:12 via @deploy-bot: https://deploys/redwood/1.4.3. Canary ramp scheduled.
tim: Is p99 affected or only p95?
sasha: p99 up slightly to ~980ms. p95 most visible for synthetic workload.
oncall: Please paste exact repro steps so oncall can run a head-to-head. Also capture x-request-id headers.
sasha: Repro: spawn 200 concurrent RPS for 30s against `/v1/generate?synth=100` with header `X-Cohort: synth-100`. Hook `x-request-id` & `x-latency-ms`. Histogram shows a clear p95 bump at ~09:14.
reza: Hypothesis: the new kernel selector in 1.4.3 may pick an alternate matmul kernel for short sequences; it increases tail for single-token batches. Suggest bisecting with `--kernel-prefer=legacy` vs `optimized`. Also test `--batching.max_tokens=64` vs `128`.
aj: Can we route synth-100 traffic back to baseline 1.4.2 quickly? If metrics drop, confirms runtime change.
maria: I see host-level anomalies on canary hosts at 09:13 — CPU %idle drop and softirq spikes in sar. Could be scheduling or IRQ affinity.
sasha: I flipped routing for cohort synth-100 back to 1.4.2 at 09:40, watching metrics now.
infra-bot: rollback executed by @sasha: https://deploys/redwood/rollback/1.4.3->1.4.2 :white_check_mark:
tim: Good containment. Plan: run controlled bisect matrix: 1) kernel selector, 2) batching policy, 3) scheduler flags. Collect per-token latency and KV-cache-hit metrics for each run.
aj: I'll kick off the bisect job on staging with the synth harness and post logs.
support: Notified affected customer, offered routing to older runtime and runbook summary. :thumbsup:
sasha: Thanks all — will gather traces + sar dumps + bisect outputs and create a postmortem doc once we confirm root cause. Will follow up with remediation plan (hotfix vs full rollback) and perf regression test to add to CI.
